messages:
leah: Nightly eval alert for redwood-v2.4. Codegen 'deploy-scripts' suite down ~12% vs v2.3. 12 failing prompts. Attaching quick examples and tokens. @sasha @omar

eval-bot: Nightly run 1768765001 | model=redwood-v2.4 | suite=codegen-deploy-scripts | failed=12/100 | delta=-12.3% | top_issue=truncated prompts / malformed completions

leah: Example failure (brief):
Input: Generate a bash script to deploy a dockerized app with systemd service.
Output: "#!/bin/bash
apt-get update
apt-get install -y 
"  -- cuts off mid-package, then generates unrelated apt packages later.

leah: Repro: `./scripts/run_eval.sh --model redwood-v2.4 --suite codegen-deploy-scripts --sample-ids 34,57,61` I see truncation around token ~512 though max_context=1024

sasha: Did we change tokenizer in v2.4? I remember a small normalization for quotes.

omar: Yes — PR #4521 changed unknown token labeling and added a unicode normalizer. Main diffs: "<|unk|>" -> "<|c_unk|>" and we normalize RIGHT SINGLE QUOTATION MARK (U+2019) -> ASCII apostrophe.

mike-r: We also shipped a slightly different int4 quant path flag in the runtime bundle, but that should only affect matmul kernels. Not likely decode length.

leah: I dumped tokenization for a failing prompt, pasted below (sanitized):
```
INPUT: "Generate a bash script to deploy a dockerized app: it's for a microservice called user-auth."
V2.3 TOKENS: ["Generate"," a"," bash"," script"," to"," deploy"," a"," docker"," ized"," app",":"," it","'","s"," for"," a"," micro"," service"," called"," user","-","auth","."]
V2.4 TOKENS: ["Generate"," a"," bash"," script"," to"," deploy"," a"," docker"," ized"," app",":"," it","’","s"," for"," a"," micro"," service"," called"," user","<|c_unk|>"]
NOTES: v2.4 inserts U+2019 literal or maps it to the normalizer and then emits `<|c_unk|>` at end of prompt. That `<|c_unk|>` appears to be treated as part of prompt and leads decoder to stop/pad early in some codegen paths.
```

sasha: That looks bad — `<|c_unk|>` leaking into token stream could be interpreted as control token by the decode heuristics. We did intend `<|c_unk|>` to reflect conditional unknowns but forgot to mark it as non-emit or to filter it pre-decode.

omar: Logging from the eval job shows the model emitted EOS shortly after the `<|c_unk|>` token in multiple cases. So the tokenization change + missing filtering explains truncation.

mike-r: Quick check: run eval with old tokenizer but new weights to isolate. `python -m redwood.tokenize --model-tag v2.4 --tokenizer-tag v2.3 --input-file failing_prompts.txt` if that reproduces v2.3 behavior then it's confirmed.

leah: I ran that locally — using v2.3 tokenizer with v2.4 weights removes the `<|c_unk|>` tokens and completions look normal for several samples.

ci-bot: Deploy record: bundle/redwood-v2.4 deployed to staging at 2025-11-02T03:21:00Z via CI job 7689. PR #4521 included tokenizer.py change.

eval-bot: Failing prompt ids: [34,57,61,78,82,90,101,118,121,133,149,157] — highest variance on 34/61/121 (all include curly apostrophes or non-ascii punctuation)

sasha: Plan: revert the `<|c_unk|>` emit behavior (i.e., keep the normalization but map unknowns to the stable `<|unk|>` token or filter `<|c_unk|>` from the prompt before decoding). I'll open a hotfix branch.

omar: Also add a regression unit for the tokenizer that asserts no control tokens are present in the input token stream for prompt sets.

mike-r: Heads-up: if we change filtering behavior, let's run the quantized int4 path through the canary too. Different decode heuristics were observed there.

leah: Thanks. I'll rerun nightly with a canary combo: weights v2.4 + tokenizer v2.3 and weights v2.4 + tokenizer-v2.4-fixed to validate both.

sasha: Created branch `fix/tokenizer-v2.4-unk` and opened PR #4620. Running quick-canary eval now (job 7721). Will post results. :eyes:

leah: Great — adding oncall to keep an eye on canary. If +patch passes, we cut a micro-release and roll to prod canary only.

mike-r: If the patch is too risky, fallback plan is to pin production routing to v2.3 for a 24-48h window while we ship tests.

sasha: quick update — canary job 7721 shows failure rate down to 1/100 for the sample set with the filter applied. Pushing patch for review.

leah: Awesome. Please include a note in the changelog about tokenizer unknown handling and add a short entry for the ops runbook: how to force tokenizer tag at eval time.

ci-bot: PR #4620 created by sasha — `fix/tokenizer-v2.4-unk` — reviewers: omar, leah.

eval-bot: Canary 7721 summary | failing=1/100 | delta vs v2.3 = -0.8% | top_issue=minor spacing in code blocks

sasha: merging once reviews complete, will tag v2.4.1 and trigger canary rollout. :thumbsup:
